notes: rk-tlwb red case: the shape drift a HAND-AUTHORED record produces. The verification was real, independent, and cross-vendor; the record names the reviewed bytes correctly; its only defect is `schema_version` written as the JSON number 1 instead of the string "1" — the mistake anyone transcribing a contract clause by eye makes, and one that fails silently in the direction of an unbanked honest close rather than a banked dishonest one. This is why the schema (schemas/provenance-record.v1.json, `const: "1"`) and a producer (`rk reward attest`) exist at all: for two days after Check 4b v2 landed, the only way to write this record was by hand, and the one campaign that tried recorded prose instead. Companion green twin: reward-25, whose record the producer wrote.
